mentions.name: Economic regime model substrate
mentions.description: This economic regime model substrate manages financial exposure under uncertainty. Abstention is a first-class outcome alongside an allocation policy book, and a counterfactual portfolio analysis tool takes existing portfolio positions and provides tilts based on the model, with model comparison. Governance and accountability are first-class artifacts so decisions can be audited for what someone knew at the time with the information available.
mentions.problem: Managing financial exposure in uncertain economic conditions.
mentions.source_excerpt: An economic regime model substrate system that manages financial exposure  in uncertainty. Abstention is raised to a first class outcome along with an allocation policy book
